verdict.rationale: Alloy is an API-first decisioning service, so it can run without a UI. The Events and Evaluation APIs return machine-readable results (evaluations[] array, services status object, 206 warnings). Workflows can also run on a schedule as Portfolio workflows, and a /healthcheck endpoint supports automated checks. However, nothing documents a CLI, CI/CD integration, or a sandbox/test-mode pattern for running Alloy inside pipelines. Missing for 10: a CLI or official CI integration (e.g., GitHub Actions), documented test/sandbox environments for automated pipelines, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation workflows.
